scope: Fresh mall directory scope: Paragon, Singapore. Official store-detail pages were checked against current public-access SFA records by exact outlet name, mall, postal code, and unit. Only blank outlet contact fields proposed. No delivery-platform content or paid services used.
method: For each proposal, the official Paragon store-detail page contains the outlet name, matching unit number, and telephone number. Workbook record matched on outlet identity and exact postal code 238859, with unit tokens matching. Existing nonblank fields were preserved. Paragon site footer hours are mall-level (10am-10pm daily), so no outlet-hours values were proposed. Search index retrieval was used to inspect official page content; raw page bytes and cryptographic page hashes were not captured.

withheld: Opening hours shown in the general Paragon footer were withheld because they are not outlet-specific.
No official outlet website URL was shown on the checked store-detail pages.
